scope: Source-only follow-up on trial timing and preprocessing; no response file, label values or performance inspected
verified_from_sources: Publisher describes ordinary stimulus presentations of750ms followed by approximately1000ms; the fixed interval depends on recording rate. Stimuli are triggered on microscope frames.
compile_resp aligns sresp columns with istim length; runspeed_discrimination indexes the corresponding all_running vector using those trial indices.

The public compile_resp helper standardizes neural responses across all stimulus trials after spontaneous normalization and defaults to every-fourth-trial evaluation. It cannot be reused unchanged for our train-only normalization and chronological split requirements.
inferences: A32trial history spans roughly56seconds, so treating32trial responses as32bins of the previous spontaneous time series would silently change the temporal task.
This release may support a separate trial-level running decoder, but it is not yet verified as an exact continuous-history replication.
